<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with intensities decreasing roughly according to the natural abundance of ^13C (≈1.1 %). The relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 8 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.5 % of M, etc.) match the expected binomial distribution for a molecule containing several carbon atoms, and no other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) is present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
